reviews.t: Get the Best from your Mascara!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:d1b695c8df165396d5c30f561946a120]] I regularly use a face primer and an eye primer, so I figured it was high time I got on the last primer train. I'm glad I did, because this last primer from Radiant Complex has really taken my mascara to new heights!  No mascara can meet every need, even high-priced ones. With this lash primer I was able to use a typical drug store brand and make it look like I had put on something couture and high quality. This primer goes on easy and feels like it's

I am so impressed with this Lash Primer by Radiant Complex. I actually have never used an eyelash primer before because I always like how my lashes look with mascara alone, so I just didn't think I need it. But I am so glad I gave it a try! It helps make my lashes look so much nicer than just mascara. It almost makes them look like false lashes. They don't look too thick, like I was expecting. They're just very pretty and defined. You can even use it on your eyebrows to help keep them in place.

This product is exactly what I was looking for!  My lashes have thinned as I have gotten older, and mascara just wasn't working for me.  It was too heavy and my lashes stuck together, making my eyes look even worse than before.  What I wanted was a lighter look to accompany the overall lighter make-up look that I now prefer.  I had never used a lash primer; did not even know such a thing existed until I overheard some other women at the cosmetic counter discussing it.  After receiving this produ

This is amazing. I've been using it as a primer for my majorlica majorca fiber lash mascara. It really helps my lashes. Mascara removal is so much easier now at night; I'm no longer accidentally pulling out my lashes while trying to clean my face!  To apply, you only need to barely blink your lashes on the brush. A very light hand is needed. Your lashes shouldn't be covered in the white primer. I think the other reviewers who had issues with this product clumping were using way too much or maybe

I love it! I put it on before my normal mascara and it completely lengthens my lashes! I have pretty short eyelashes, I often feel that mascara alone doesn't do the job. This def changed that for me. It also makes the color of your mascara really stand out. I also love the packaging and the look of the product; other people might not care about this but I for some reason or another I do. I would without a doubt purchase this again! Great Find! I so very gratefully received this product for a sli

reviews.t: Made in USA!!!  Very important to me!
reviews.x: This is much better than I expected!  So excited it is made in the USA!!!  I will certainly but it again! The Lash Primer is just what I want and at a great price as well.  Much better than the department store in all ways. The seller sent tips on using, very helpful.

I have tried many high end lash primers over the years, and this product beats them all!!  It conditions, separates, and primes the lashes for an awesome application of mascara!  I also have been using it at bedtime to condition my lashes and I have had less fallout and my lashes are fuller and longer than ever.  This is a great product!

Love this Primer! Not irritating! Does really make a difference - gives you volume and length prior to putting Mascara! Definitely looks like Falsies. reviews.t: Good primer, slightly pricey for off-brand
reviews.x: Great lash primer. Works as expected, but I do find it pretty pricey for an off-brand product. I use primers to help build my mascara so I can use less mascara and decrease the time it takes. I do one layer primer, follow with one layer mascara, another layer of primer, finish with another layer of mascara. This builds great volume and it doesn't make the mascara flake off or anything. I don't wait for it to dry between layers just FYI. I'm happy with the product overall.

reviews.t: I LOST 17 LASHES IN ONE USE.
reviews.x: This product was awful! It made my lashes brittle and dry. My final straw was when I lost 17 lashes in one eye alone. YES, I COUNTED! I was horrified![[ASIN:B00VKOHS2I Lash Primer by Radiant Complex I Best Eyelash and Eyebrow Conditioner to Enhance and Prime Mascara!]] Record breaker. NEVER again. I have returned to my Jane Iredale. This experience taught me to never trust certain reviews.

reviews.t: Gives that mascara a boost and conditions lashes too
reviews.x: I have never tried a lash primer and never really knew it existed until I saw this. Because I am getting older and we lose that wonderful thick lash look we have we are younger i thought it would be great to use to condition my lashes and keep them healthier and maybe keep from losing some. I didn't expect it to be white but it does make it easier to see when you apply it. I found it easier to apply by brushing across my lashing instead of brushing base to tip. I even used the very end of the br

I am not sure how I used to apply mascara before getting this item, it goes on very smoothly, dries quickly, I usually apply it as the last part of my make-up routine right before apply black mascara. It makes your lashes look longer and fuller even if you don't add a colored mascara on top of it but I usually prefer to. Have been using it for 2 months now with no problems or irritation. I highly recommend this item and this seller and will be buying it again when it runs out.

reviews.t: but this one was a better value. this one takes longer to dry (usually ...
reviews.x: the only other primer I used was clinique's. I prefer clinique's, but this one was a better value. this one takes longer to dry (usually I don't wait bc I'm in a rush), but it still creates the illusion of long, separated lashes.

I LOVE Radiant Complex.  It gives my thin eyelashes volume and length.  Yes, I've tried other more expensive & less expensive Lash Primers (very famous brands) but this Lash Primer by Radiant Complex does a better job, lasts longer and has more ounces in the container and of course IS the better product.  It is easy to apply, no irritation (and I have very sensitive eyes) and doesn't clump or flake off.  This is the 3rd Lash Primer brand I have tried but Radiant Complex will now be my "go to

Used eyelash primer for the first time to help lashes be fuller and mascara to stay put...so pleasantly surprised how great the product is. I've used it for about 2 weeks daily and feel like I have decent lashes again. I combine this with my other fave IT Tightline mascara & other volume mascara, so now  lashes have all-day wear without flaking or smudging. Great product that I'll continue to use. Also saw its made in the USA! Bonus!

I love my lash primer! I put it on after using my eyelash curler...I apply it just like mascara...make sure I keep brushing until the clumps are good then immediately apply my $5 mascara and tadah! Long nice lashes! I get compliments all the time by random strangers and I always show them exactly how to order it! I'm on my second tube of it.... It lasts about 2 months and I pay about $19 for it and it's worth EVERY penny!

Love, Love, Love this primer! I apply it first and then apply mascara immediately after. It makes my eyelashes look so long!  Update: been using the same primer for 7 months and it's still works like a charm! The picture is kind of awkward, but that's the only way to show how long my lashes are!! Just placed a second order and I will continue to use this as long as they make it! 👍

Lash primers are difficult to find.  This one was rated higher than most so I ordered it.  I followed the directions and quickly applied mascara after the primer was applied.  Mascara did not smudge and seemed more evenly spread on lashes.  However, the primer itself started to clump on specific lashes.  It is a good, but not excellent product, and the price is reasonable.

reviews.t: They look so much longer and thicker almost like I was wearing flash eyelashes
reviews.x: I have never used eyelash primer. I was watching a video about using it and decided to give it a try. What a dramatic difference in my eyelashes. They look so much longer and thicker almost like I was wearing flash eyelashes. I don't know why I have not tried this before, but I will definitely be using it from now on.

I struggled for years with my mascara. It took so long to apply and I never felt I got the length I wanted. I love the primer. I spend much less time applying my makeup and I get the length I am looking for. I will add, the mascara I use makes a difference. A cheap or watered down mascara won't do the trick.

I absolutely love this product! If I use two coats of primer and two coats of mascara, I get the results I want every single time. Follow the instructions to apply the primer and mascara to one eye before applying to the second, in order to get smooth coverage. I think the price is well worth the results.

This product does not do as well as I would like.  It has been difficult to get it to stick to my lashes and doesn't give the lengthening I was hoping for.  It comes out quite thick on the brush and needs to be wiped off a bit because it is just too much to go on the lashes well.

I was looking for a replacement primer as my lashes are thin and need a little help to look naturally thick. This was reasonably priced and worked well. I let it dry completely before applying my mascara .... which is a personal preference.

Love this primer I use every day before my mascara and it makes my lashes super long and lush! I do use two mascaras and latisse and was having a problem with broken lashes before using this product. Excuse my duck face in the pic lol

I have used several different primers over the years.  They all worked well BUT this one is really Tops.  I have short lashes;however, when using this primer my lashes look long and thick after using mascara.  Great Product!!

claims.text: Reviewers say it makes lashes look longer, fuller, and more voluminous, often comparing the effect to falsies.
Many reviewers say it conditions lashes and reduces fallout or damage, though one reviewer reported losing lashes and dryness.
Several reviewers say it outperforms more expensive or high-end lash primers and offers good value.
Some reviewers note it takes longer to dry or requires careful application to work correctly.
A few reviewers mention it is pricey for an off-brand product or that they prefer another brand.
